title: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report — US crude, gasoline and distillate stocks (10:30 ET, decision-day morning)
source: EST: eia.gov/petroleum/supply/weekly/schedule.php, fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200) — the page states the standard release is 'after 10:30 a.m. eastern time on Wednesday', and its 2026 Holiday Release Schedule table lists exceptions only on 01-22, 02-19, 05-28, 09-10, 10-15 and 11-12, i.e. no September exception after 09-10. 2026-09-16 is a Wednesday, so the standard rule applies. Filed estimate on two counts: the date is derived from the publisher's own stated rule plus weekday arithmetic rather than named on a dated schedule, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the same reasoning shape labor-day-market-closure-2026-09-07 documented. Checked 2026-09-10
notes: DISCOVERED IN THE fomc-2026-09-16 D-6 ADJACENCY SWEEP (2026-09-10). It is proposed for one reason and it is an ATTRIBUTION reason, not a policy one: this calendar tracks the monthly oil reports that bracket the corridor (eia-steo-2026-09-09, opec-momr-2026-09-10, iea-omr-2026-09-11) but not the weekly US inventory print that lands INSIDE it, at 10:30 ET on the morning of the FOMC statement. That makes decision-day morning five dated items deep — retail sales + import/export prices 08:30, NAHB HMI 10:00, this 10:30, statement 14:00, TIC 16:00 — against the three the fomc-2026-09-16 ledger logged at D-8. It matters more on this particular Wednesday than on an ordinary one because the oil channel is the loudest input on that ledger's board: Brent went 97.92 (09-08) to 101.21 (09-09) to 108.95 (09-10), +9.6% in two sessions and the first triple-digit print of the event's life, after US forces destroyed five Iranian tankers in the Gulf of Oman and near Kharg Island and Houthi strikes hit four Saudi facilities, with Hormuz tanker traffic reported down to ~10 ships a day against a strait that normally carries ~20 mb/d. A US crude and distillate draw or build published four hours before a policy statement, in the middle of a supply shock, is a real attribution hazard for any 10:30-to-14:00 move on 09-16. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is tiered low deliberately: no house playbook is energy-keyed, no tracked symbol carries direct crude exposure, and an ordinary weekly inventory print is inert tape. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
